# DGTL Sunrise

dgtl-connector is a Grok Bot plugin that connects agents to marketing accounts you already administer. Free GA4, Search Console, and Tag Manager reads run on your machine. Pro ($19/mo) adds a hosted Google Ads and Meta gateway with confirm-gated writes. Install: `grok plugin install dgtlsunrise/dgtl-connector` (also Grok Build and Cursor).

## When to use this

Use this index when an agent needs a short map of public docs, APIs, and install facts. Prefer the structured agent document for machine-readable endpoints and capabilities. Prefer the full text when you need platforms, guardrails, and company detail in one place.

## Agent notes

Send `Accept: text/markdown` (preferring text/markdown over text/html) for companion markdown twins of HTML pages. Homepage `/?mode=agent` returns application/json from `agent.json` and wins over HTML and markdown negotiation for that query.
